given.note: Staging's check tester (QUESTIONS.md CQ-214 (a); README default 105) as its seed card writes it. No frozen seed holds it (K-36: 'No seed names a member of Rosie's team'), so this exchange's database side writes its rows itself: persons person-check-tester (name and language null, version 1); handles handle-check-tester-email (email, check-tester@example.com); person_handles (person-check-tester, handle-check-tester-email); team_page_recipients team-check-tester (person_id person-check-tester, chat_handle_id null, email_handle_id handle-check-tester-email, added_at 2026-11-12T04:00:00Z, removed_at null, version 1); proof_codes code-check-tester-seed (purpose sign_in, person_id person-check-tester, business_id null, sent_to_handle_id handle-check-tester-email, channel email, code_hash 0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f00f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0, hash_key_name PROOF_CODE_HASH_KEY, sent_at 2026-11-12T04:00:00Z, expires_at 2026-11-12T04:10:00Z, wrong_tries 0, used_at 2026-11-12T04:00:00Z, version 2); sessions session-check-tester (person_id person-check-tester, token_sha256 a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90, device_sha256 null, proven_via code, proof_code_id code-check-tester-seed, started_at and last_seen_at 2026-11-12T04:00:00Z, expires_at 2026-12-12T04:00:00Z, ended_at and ended_why null, version 1). Five minutes after the seed, the automated check's testPhoneSend carries the token, and the page entry sends its sha256 alone: session_for_token finds the live session and its person, who holds a live team row as the test console's member (K-21 default 2), so tester. The two hashes are stand-ins, the hash of no token and no code; the ids and the address are examples.
